title: Brent offered Secret Agent Man by Barry Sonnenfeld

tellings.quote: years later, I'm offered a job on a show with Barry Senfeld as the executive producer called Secret Agent Man.

plain: In the late 1990s in Los Angeles, the screenwriter Brent Friedman was offered a job on a spy television show called Secret Agent Man, with the film director Barry Sonnenfeld as executive producer. Friedman tells it himself, "years later," in an episode about Hollywood, the CIA and UFOs, as one step in his own career in that world.
